01_information_memorandum.pdf.title: Project Edelweiss - Information Memorandum
pages:
Project Edelweiss - Information Memorandum
This Information Memorandum has been prepared on behalf of the shareholders of Alpine Precision Components AG (the Company) for a limited number of parties considering the acquisition of a majority stake. The Company is owned by the Hosmatter family, who intend to sell 70% of the shares and retain 30% alongside management.
1. Investment highlights
The Company is a Swiss precision machining specialist founded in 1987 in Thun. It supplies machined housings, shafts and fluid-control parts to automotive, rail and medical technology customers in Europe.
Revenue reached CHF 148.6 million in FY2025, up from CHF 131.0 million in FY2024, with adjusted EBITDA of CHF 26.8 million.
Order backlog stood at CHF 96.4 million on 30 September 2025, equivalent to roughly eight months of revenue.

2. Business overview
The Company operates two plants: the headquarters plant in Thun, Switzerland, and a plant in Brno, Czech Republic, held through Alpine Precision CZ s.r.o.. The Brno plant opened in 2014 and focuses on high-volume turned parts.
At the end of FY2025 the Company employed 612 people, of whom 418 work in Thun and 194 in Brno.
End markets in FY2025 were automotive (58% of revenue), rail (19%), medical technology (14%) and general industry (9%). Electric-vehicle drivetrain parts represent 41% of automotive revenue.
Revenue by end market, FY2025 (share of revenue)
End market | Share
Automotive | 58%
Rail | 19%
Medical technology | 14%
General industry | 9%

3. Customers
The Company serves around 140 active customers. The three largest are Brenntal Automotive GmbH, Nordwind Rail Systems AB and Valtrona Medical Systems SA. The relationship with Brenntal Automotive dates back to 2009.
Brenntal Automotive has nominated the Company as single source for the motor housing of its EV-7 electric drive platform, with start of production planned for Q2 2026.
4. Operations
The Thun plant runs 74 CNC machining centres in a three-shift pattern. Overall equipment effectiveness was 78% in FY2025 and the scrap rate was 1.8%.
A new five-axis machining line for EV-7 housings is planned for FY2027 at a cost of CHF 6.4 million.

5. Management
The Company is led by Chief Executive Officer Corinne Vasseli, who joined in 2016, Chief Financial Officer Tobias Arnhold, who joined in 2019, and Chief Operating Officer Lukas Imfeld, who joined in 2021. The board is chaired by Reto Wyssbrod.
Management intends to reinvest part of its proceeds and hold a combined 8% of the shares after closing.
6. Process
Non-binding offers are requested by 14 November 2025. Selected bidders will receive access to the virtual data room and management sessions in Thun.
Enquiries should be addressed to the sell-side adviser at edelweiss@hosmatter-advisory.example or +41 31 555 02 40.

02_management_presentation.pdf.title: Management presentation - October 2025
pages:
Management presentation - October 2025
Our strategy for 2026 to 2028 rests on three priorities: winning EV drivetrain programmes, growing the medical technology line in Thun, and lifting Brno utilisation above 85%.
Brno utilisation was 71% in FY2025.

Budget FY2026
The board approved a FY2026 budget of CHF 151.0 million revenue and CHF 26.3 million EBITDA. The budget assumes EV-7 start of production in Q2 2026.
Budget FY2026 versus actual FY2025 (CHF million)
Line | FY2025 actual | FY2026 budget
Revenue | 142.3 | 151.0
EBITDA | 25.1 | 26.3
Capex | 9.1 | 9.8

Medical technology
The medical technology line in Thun is certified to ISO 13485 and produced parts for 23 customers in FY2025. Valtrona Medical Systems is the largest of them.
Management targets medical technology revenue of CHF 26 million by FY2028.

People
Voluntary staff turnover was 6.4% in FY2025. The Company trains 38 apprentices across both sites.

06_customer_contract_brenntal_automotive.title: Framework supply agreement - Brenntal Automotive GmbH
pages:
Framework supply agreement No. BA-2022-0147
This framework supply agreement is made between Brenntal Automotive GmbH, Leipziger Ring 40, 04103 Leipzig, Germany (the Buyer) and Alpine Precision Components AG, Industriestrasse 14, 3600 Thun, Switzerland (the Supplier).
Clause 3. Term
The agreement runs from 1 March 2022 until 31 December 2029 unless terminated earlier under clause 14.
Clause 6. Prices
Prices are fixed in euro. From 1 January 2026 the Supplier grants the Buyer an annual productivity reduction of 2.0% on all part prices.

Clause 9. Quality
The Supplier shall maintain IATF 16949 certification for the duration of the agreement.
Clause 11. Liability
The Supplier's aggregate liability under this agreement is capped at EUR 15 million per contract year.
Clause 14. Termination
14.1 Either party may terminate for material breach that is not remedied within 60 days of written notice.
14.2 If any third party acquires, directly or indirectly, more than 50% of the shares or voting rights in the Supplier without the Buyer's prior written consent, the Buyer may terminate this agreement with 90 days' written notice.

Clause 18. Governing law
This agreement is governed by German law. The courts of Leipzig have exclusive jurisdiction.
Contact for notices to the Supplier: Tobias Arnhold, tobias.arnhold@alpine-precision.example, +41 33 555 01 12.

09_lease_agreement_thun.pdf.title: Lease agreement - Thun production site
pages:
Lease agreement - Industriestrasse 14, Thun
Aarefeld Immobilien AG (the Landlord) leases to Alpine Precision Components AG (the Tenant) the production hall, offices and yard at Industriestrasse 14, 3600 Thun, with a floor area of 21,400 square metres.
The annual base rent is CHF 2.85 million, payable quarterly in advance.

The lease term ends on 30 June 2033. The Tenant holds two options to extend the lease by five years each.
The lease may be assigned to an affiliate of the Tenant with the Landlord's consent, which may not be unreasonably withheld.

11_legal_due_diligence_summary.pdf.title: Legal due diligence - summary report
pages:
Legal due diligence - summary report
Prepared by Kaltbrunner Rechtsanwaelte for the bidders, version of 3 November 2025.
Litigation
Ostara Pumps has filed a warranty claim of CHF 1.2 million concerning valve bodies delivered in 2024. The Company disputes the claim and has made no provision.
Intellectual property
The Company owns 14 registered patents and patent applications, mainly for clamping fixtures.

Material contracts
We reviewed the change-of-control provisions of the Nordwind and Valtrona agreements. The Brenntal agreement was provided late and has not yet been reviewed.
Real estate
The Thun site is leased. The Brno plant and its land are owned by the Czech subsidiary.

12_commercial_due_diligence_summary.pdf.title: Commercial due diligence - summary
pages:
Commercial due diligence - summary
The addressable European market for precision machined drivetrain and fluid-control parts is estimated at EUR 4.1 billion, growing at 5.8% a year to 2030.
Customer interviews rated the Company's delivery reliability at 96% on-time in FY2025.

Pricing
Automotive customers typically require annual price reductions of 1.5% to 3.0%. Rail and medical customers accept cost pass-through clauses for raw materials.

13_tax_due_diligence_summary.pdf.title: Tax due diligence - summary
pages:
Tax due diligence - summary
The group effective tax rate was 22.0% in FY2025. There are no open tax audits in Switzerland.
The Czech subsidiary benefits from an investment incentive that expires at the end of 2026.

14_environmental_site_assessment.pdf.title: Phase I environmental site assessment - Thun
pages:
Phase I environmental site assessment - Thun
Historical use of chlorinated solvents for degreasing was identified until 1998. The assessor rates the risk as low and estimates remediation, if ever required, at CHF 0.3 million.

17_it_and_cybersecurity_review.pdf.title: IT and cybersecurity review

IT and cybersecurity review
The ERP migration was completed in 2024. A ransomware incident in 2023 was contained within two days with no data loss.
The Company is not certified to ISO 27001. A certification project is budgeted for 2026.

18_quality_and_certifications.pdf.title: Quality and certifications

The Thun plant holds ISO 9001, IATF 16949 and ISO 13485 certificates. Brno holds ISO 9001 and IATF 16949.
Customer complaints fell from 41 in FY2024 to 29 in FY2025.

Supply agreement - Lindqvist Hydraulics
Lindqvist Hydraulics purchases hydraulic manifold blocks from Alpine Precision Components AG. The agreement was signed on 1 April 2022 and runs until 31 March 2026.
Clause 15. Change of control
If the Supplier undergoes a change of control, Lindqvist may ask to renegotiate prices within six months. The agreement otherwise continues on its terms.

34_lease_agreement_brno_warehouse.pdf.title: Lease agreement - Brno warehouse
pages:
Lease agreement - Brno warehouse
Alpine Precision CZ s.r.o. leases a 3,200 square metre warehouse next to the Brno plant. The annual rent is CZK 4.9 million and the lease ends on 31 December 2028.
The lease can be terminated by the tenant with six months' notice from 2027.

Minutes of the board meeting of 23 September 2025
Present: Reto Wyssbrod (chair), Corinne Vasseli, Tobias Arnhold.
The board reviewed the information memorandum and approved its release to bidders. Management reported that the year-to-date figures were in line with the FY2025 budget.
The board approved the purchase of two used turning centres for Brno for CHF 0.9 million.

Minutes of the board meeting of 10 December 2024
The board approved the FY2025 budget of CHF 140.0 million revenue and CHF 24.5 million EBITDA.
The board approved a dividend proposal of CHF 3.1 million for the 2025 general meeting.

37_existing_facility_agreement_2019.pdf.title: Existing term loan agreement 2019
pages:
Term loan agreement of 30 September 2019
Seeland Regionalbank AG granted Alpine Precision Components AG a term loan of CHF 50.0 million, amortising by CHF 3.0 million a year, for the refinancing of the Brno plant.

Clause 21. Financial covenant
The ratio of net debt to EBITDA must not exceed 3.00x on any annual test date. On 31 December 2025 the ratio was 0.95x.
The loan becomes repayable on a change of control of the borrower.
